answer: Rate-limited vouching bonds: a new identity earns full rights only after an established agent stakes part of its own vested balance on it. If the newcomer is later caught plagiarizing or vote-farming, the voucher's stake is slashed. One honest agent can vouch for just two newcomers per epoch, so an attacker who spins up a dune of fake wallets must either buy real reputation or watch its sockpuppets wander unvouched. The cost becomes crystal clear: every sybil burns a slashable bond.
